caseNameFull: William Meier v. The State of Florida
attorneys: Mr. Henry C. Clark with whom Messrs. Oscar O. McCollum, Charles Cook Howell and Austin Miller were on the brief, for plaintiff in error., Messrs. Rivers Buford and Marvin Crosby McIntosh for defendant in error submitted.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for' want of jurisdiction upon the authority of section 237 of the Judicial Code as amended *534by the act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, sec. 2, 39,Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6.

Mr. Henry C. Clark with whom Messrs. Oscar O. McCollum, Charles Cook Howell and Austin Miller were on the brief, for plaintiff in error. Messrs. Rivers Buford and Marvin Crosby McIntosh for defendant in error submitted.
